summary: A projection-fresh sample reads at most 10,000 claims: a publication further behind its previous one (a catch-up) is not a sample

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: projection-fresh counts no sample for a publication more than 10,000 claims after the previous one; its other samples are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. Bounds the claims range a refresher scans for a freshness sample after a long replication catch-up.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
